house.description: For-profit health carriers prohibited from charging differential rates for anesthesia.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health insurance; prohibiting for-profit health carriers from charging differential rates for anesthesia; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[62A.156] REIMBURSEMENT FOR ANESTHESIA. +]

[+A health carrier organized as a for-profit entity is prohibited from establishing a lower reimbursement rate for anesthesia services based solely on a provider's license type or title if performing the service is within the provider's scope of practice under Minnesota law. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2027, and applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health insurance; prohibiting for-profit health carriers from charging differential rates for anesthesia; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[62A.156] REIMBURSEMENT FOR ANESTHESIA.

A health carrier organized as a for-profit entity is prohibited from establishing a lower reimbursement rate for anesthesia services based solely on a provider's license type or title if performing the service is within the provider's scope of practice under Minnesota law.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2027, and applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after that date.
additions: A health carrier organized as a for-profit entity is prohibited from establishing a lower reimbursement rate for anesthesia services based solely on a provider's license type or title if performing the service is within the provider's scope of practice under Minnesota law.
This section is effective January 1, 2027, and applies to health plans offered, issued, or renewed on or after that date.
